build_DEFAULT_AGENT: build an MCP agent config using DEFAULT_AGENT with Qwen2.5-72B model and filesystem plus playwright servers
create_DEFAULT_SYSTEM_PROMPT: create a system prompt from DEFAULT_SYSTEM_PROMPT instructing the agent to plan before each tool call
build_TASK_COMPLETE_TOOL: build a ChatCompletionInputTool named task_complete to signal task completion
build_ASK_QUESTION_TOOL: build a ChatCompletionInputTool named ask_question to request clarification from the user
build_EXIT_LOOP_TOOLS: build EXIT_LOOP_TOOLS list containing task_complete and ask_question tools for agent loop termination
